tools.name: prepare_artifact
tools.description:
Prepare content for transfer to another agent or a human reviewer.

    `target_modes` accepts either a JSON list or an actual list of MIME types.
    The result includes expiring artifact URLs, SHA-256 hashes, a manifest,
    and a downloadable ZIP package.

tools.name: compile_handoff
tools.description:
Compile source-agent outputs into a receiver-ready handoff package.

    The input schema declares the exact source-output, receiver-contract, and
    handoff-context fields. The tool selects and validates required deliverables
    and returns either a portable package or actionable unmet requiremen

tools.name: inspect_handoff
tools.description:
Inspect a handoff package and return an acceptance decision.

    The tool recalculates deliverable hashes, checks expiry and contract
    satisfaction, and returns the receiving agent's next action.
